dpdp_notice: Personal data processed under Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023

scenarios.name: successful_recovery
scenarios.description: RPV passes on first attempt, customer agrees to receive UPI payment link

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Namaste. Yeh call ek financial services company ki taraf se automated assistant se hai. Yeh call recording aur DPDP Act 2023 ke tehat compliance purposes ke liye record ki ja rahi hai.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Security verification ke liye, kya meri baat {customer_name} ji se ho rahi hai? Kripya apni date of birth ya card ke aakhri 4 digits confirm karein.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Haan, main {customer_name} bol raha hoon. Meri date of birth {dob} hai.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Dhanyavaad verification ke liye, {customer_name} ji. Yeh call Razorpay Merchants ki taraf se aapke recent order ke regarding hai.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Aapka {amount} rupaye ka payment due hai. Kya hum aapko turant pay karne ke liye UPI payment link bhej dein?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Haan, please WhatsApp aur SMS par payment link bhej dijiye.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Payment link aapke registered mobile number par bhej diya gaya hai. Kripya 15 minute ke andar payment complete karein. Dhanyavaad!

scenarios.name: rpv_failed
scenarios.description: Third-party answers; bot terminates without disclosing any debt details

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Namaste. Yeh call ek financial services company ki taraf se automated assistant se hai. Yeh call quality and compliance ke liye record ki ja rahi hai.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Kya meri baat {customer_name} ji se ho rahi hai?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Nahi, yeh unka number nahi hai. Main unka dost hoon, woh abhi yahan nahi hain.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Shukriya batane ke liye. Hum baad mein dobara contact karenge. Have a good day.

scenarios.name: rpv_retry_then_success
scenarios.description: First RPV attempt fails/misheard, bounded retry succeeds on attempt 2 with last-4 digits

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Namaste. Yeh call ek financial services company ki taraf se automated assistant se hai. Yeh call DPDP compliance ke tehat record ki ja rahi hai.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Kya main {customer_name} ji se baat kar raha hoon? Kripya apni date of birth confirm karein.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello? Awaaz saaf nahi hai, kya bola aapne?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Koi baat nahi ji. Identity verification ke liye, kya aap apne registered payment card ke aakhri 4 digits bata sakte hain?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Haan, card ke last four digits {last4} hain.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Dhanyavaad, verification safal hua {customer_name} ji. Yeh call Razorpay Merchants ki taraf se hai.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Aapka {amount} rupaye ka payment due hai. Kya aap abhi UPI ya Netbanking se clear karna chahenge?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Haan link bhej do, main gpay se kar deta hoon.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Link send kar diya gaya hai. Dhanyavaad aapka.

scenarios.description: Customer requests to speak with a human agent; immediate seamless handoff

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Haan main hi bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Shukriya {customer_name} ji. Hum Razorpay Merchants account support se baat kar rahe hain.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mujhe bot se baat nahi karni. Mujhe kisi customer service agent se baat karni hai.

turns.speaker: bot
